item.statement: The contract admits no numerical tolerance: the migrated operator must be bitwise exact and stable across repeated executions with identical inputs.

plans.objective: Show there is no rounding drift and no tolerance by comparing repeated and inverse runs bitwise.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact and run the repeated and inverse launches on Ascend 950PR.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff both identical-input runs are bitwise identical to each other and to the host oracle, and the inverse run restores the original source exactly.
plans.setup: Run the candidate twice with identical inputs and shifts, and once with the inverse shift pair; capture all odata buffers; also compute a host floor-mod oracle.
